section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains the analogy of water reflecting a face to illustrate how the simple Ein Sof can receive the forms of the Sefiros through the arousal from below, while questioning how this is possible given Ein Sof's absolute simplicity.
section.t: And seemingly, this can be explained by first prefacing that the reason why, when one looks into water, the image of the face looking into it is seen, is because water is a pure and clear substance, devoid of all colors.
[This is unlike when one looks at something that has a picture,
the picture
(the color)
of that thing contradicts the picture of the face looking into it],
Therefore,
the concept of "water corresponding to face"
(that through the elevation of Mayin Nukvin a form is made in Ein Sof),
is simpler than the concept of "heart of man to man."
But this explanation requires additional explanation,
for seemingly,
this that in a simple thing all pictures are seen is specifically when the colors and the simple thing are of the same type,
that is, both are physical
(like the water and the face looking into them)
or both are spiritual
[in the manner of a simple logic that by virtue of its simplicity it can be pictured both in the picture of Chessed and in the picture of Gevurah,
that both
(the logic and the pictures of Chessed and Gevurah)
are spiritual],
But it is not applicable that in a simple thing pictures of a different type would be seen
[like intellectual logic,
which cannot be pictured in whiteness and redness
(physical),
and likewise conversely, it is not applicable that in physical water pictures of Chessed and Gevurah would be seen],
And since Ein Sof is abstracted not only from the picture of the Sefiros but also from the existence of the Sefiros
[for just as a spiritual thing is abstracted from the existence of physicality,
so too regarding Ein Sof, which is abstracted from the existence of the Sefiros.
For the existence of the Sefiros is that they are grasped in some definition
(Chochmah,
Binah,
etc.),
and since Ein Sof is absolutely simple and no grasp applies to it,
behold it is abstracted from the existence of the Sefiros],
How then is it applicable that through the elevation of Mayin Nukvin, Sefiros would be formed in it?

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the arousal from below causes an arousal from above not by reason, but because it arose in the primordial thought of Adam Kadmon and in the will of the Essence of Ein Sof, thereby creating a connection between the simple waters and the faces.
section.t: And the explanation of this,
is based on the known principle
that this that arousal from below arouses and draws down arousal from above
[also the arousal from above in the aspect of the Supernal Man,
Atzilus],
is not according to reason and intellect,
for since the created is incomparable to the Creator,
behold, according to intellect there is no place for the service of the creations to arouse
(effect a change)
in the matters above,
Rather, it is because so it arose in the primordial thought of Adam Kadmon
[which is before Atzilus]
that through the service of the creations there will be an arousal and drawing down of the matters of Atzilus.
And from this it is understood all the more so regarding the concept of "water corresponding to face,"
that this that through the elevation of Mayin Nukvin of the aspect of face,
the Sefiros of Atzilus,
there is an arousal from above in the aspect of the Supernal Waters,
in the simplicity of Ein Sof which is above the aspect of Man,
is because so it arose in His will, blessed be He,
in the Essence of Ein Sof which is above even the aspect of water.
And it can be said,
that through it arising in His will, blessed be He, that through the elevation of Mayin Nukvin of the aspect of face
(the Sefiros of Atzilus)
there will be a drawing down from the aspect of the Supernal Waters,
through this,
a connection is made for them to the aspect of the faces that they draw down,
in the analogy of literal water,
that they and the faces
(that look into them)
are of the same type.
Therefore,
the arousal from above in the aspect of the water that comes through the elevation of Mayin Nukvin of the Sefiros is
(not only an arousal that there will be a drawing down of Ein Sof into the Sefiros,
but also)
that in the simplicity of Ein Sof itself, the matter of the Sefiros is made,
the concealed Sefiros,
in the analogy of literal water,
in which themselves the face looking into them is seen.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the reason the drawing down from above is specifically through arousal from below is because the root of Israel is in the Essence, as the Maggid explained regarding "Israel arose in thought," and this extends to the entire concept of elevating Mayin Nukvin.
section.t: And it can be said,
that the reason for this that it arose in His will that the drawing down from above
(arousal from above)
be specifically through arousal from below,
is,
because the root of Israel
(for the main matter of arousal from below is through the service of Israel)
is in the Essence.
And as the Maggid wrote
in his explanation of the statement of our Sages, of blessed memory,
"Israel arose in thought,"
which is like the parable of a person who has a son,
that from the greatness of his love for him,
the form of the son is engraved in his thought.
And since for Him, blessed be He, the past and the future are one,
therefore the form of Israel was engraved in His thought, blessed be He, even before they were created.
This is also the concept of "He took counsel with the souls of the righteous,"
that the delight of the Holy One, blessed be He, in the service of the righteous was even before creation
(and through this creation came about).
And since the delight of the service of Israel is in His Essence, blessed be He, which is above all revelations,
therefore it arose in His will, blessed be He,
(also in the aspect of revelations)
that the drawing down and revelation from above be specifically through service.
And through this it is likewise regarding the entire concept of the elevation of Mayin Nukvin
(the elevation of Mayin Nukvin of the Sefiros and the like),
that it arose in His will, blessed be He, that the drawing down of Ein Sof be through the elevation of Mayin Nukvin of the Sefiros.
And so too is it in the primordial thought of Adam Kadmon,
that this that it arose in the primordial thought of Adam Kadmon that the drawing down from above be specifically through arousal from below,
is,
because the root of Israel is in the Essence of Adam Kadmon
[and as explained elsewhere
that this that Adam Kadmon is in the form of Man
(Primordial Man)
is the form of the souls of Israel that arose in the primordial thought of Adam Kadmon],
And from this it extends also into the thought of Adam Kadmon regarding the chain of descent,
that all the drawings down
[the drawing down from Atzilus to Beriah, Yetzirah, and Asiyah,
and also the drawing down from above Atzilus to Atzilus]
will be through service,
the elevation of Mayin Nukvin.
